affinity.notes: Undeath is conveyed through anatomy and equipment rather than elemental body construction.

anatomy.notes: Armored corpse anatomy and weapon-bearing stance are coherent.

archetype.notes: Banner commander bruiser semantically communicates a standards-commanding sovereign.

counterplay.notes: The large hooked weapon and ponderous armored stance imply committed, readable melee swings.

finish.notes: Dense detail remains legible through strong silhouette and value control.

framing.notes: Centered full-body presentation preserves the banner and hooked weapon.

identity.notes: Undead or skeletal warlord does not identify an Orc Overlord.

tier.notes: Blind reviewer perceived T4, not exact intended tier T5.
